content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80015 The call of ActivateTask across cores shall behave synchronously, i.e. a call re- turns after the Task has been activated or an error has been detected. It shall not be possible to continue execution on the calling core before ActivateTask is accom- plished on the remote core.

The call of ActivateTask across cores shall behave syn- chronously, i.e. a call returns after the Task has been activated or an error has been detected. It shall not be possible to continue execution on the calling core before ActivateTask is accomplished on the remote core.
